defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: Morocco
maps.description: Morocco is a North African country known for its diverse geography, rich Berber and Arab culture, historic walled medinas, and the scenic Atlas Mountains.

maps.name: Iraq
maps.description: Iraq is a Middle Eastern country with a profound ancient history, home to the cradle of civilization in Mesopotamia, the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, and diverse cultural heritage.

maps.name: Peru
maps.description: Peru is a South American country famous for the towering Andes Mountains, the vast Amazon rainforest, and the ancient Incan citadel of Machu Picchu.

maps.name: Venezuela
maps.description: Venezuela is a country on the northern coast of South America, known for its diverse wildlife, the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall (Angel Falls), and significant natural resources.

maps.name: Ecuador
maps.description: Ecuador is a South American country straddling the equator, globally renowned for the unique biodiversity of the Galápagos Islands, Andean highlands, and the Amazon basin.

maps.name: Dominican Republic
maps.description: The Dominican Republic is a Caribbean nation sharing the island of Hispaniola with Haiti, celebrated for its pristine beaches, merengue music, and historic colonial architecture.

maps.name: Belarus
maps.description: Belarus is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe, characterized by its vast primeval forests, thousands of serene lakes, and a rich Slavic cultural heritage.

maps.name: Serbia
maps.description: Serbia is a landlocked country in Southeast Europe, known for its vibrant capital Belgrade, historic Orthodox monasteries, and deeply rooted folk traditions.

maps.name: Bulgaria
maps.description: Bulgaria is a Balkan country with a diverse landscape encompassing a picturesque Black Sea coastline, a rugged mountainous interior, and major historic rivers like the Danube.

maps.name: Slovakia
maps.description: Slovakia is a Central European country celebrated for its well-preserved medieval castles, charming villages, and the rugged, scenic peaks of the High Tatra Mountains.

maps.name: Croatia
maps.description: Croatia is a Central European country with a stunning Adriatic coastline, historic walled cities like Dubrovnik, and beautiful national parks such as Plitvice Lakes.

maps.name: Lithuania
maps.description: Lithuania is a Baltic state in Northern Europe, known for its flat landscapes, dense forests, numerous tranquil lakes, and a rich medieval history.

maps.name: Latvia
maps.description: Latvia is a Baltic country in Northern Europe, celebrated for its vast forests, stunning Art Nouveau architecture in Riga, and a strong tradition of song and dance.

maps.name: Estonia
maps.description: Estonia is a Northern European country known for its well-preserved medieval old towns, thousands of islands, and its status as a highly advanced digital society.

maps.name: Slovenia
maps.description: Slovenia is a small, picturesque Central European country featuring Alpine mountains, emerald-green rivers, and a charming, eco-friendly capital in Ljubljana.

maps.name: Georgia
maps.description: Georgia is a country at the intersection of Eastern Europe and Western Asia, renowned for its ancient wine-making tradition, dramatic Caucasus mountains, and warm hospitality.

maps.name: Azerbaijan
maps.description: Azerbaijan is a transcontinental country at the boundary of Eastern Europe and Western Asia, famous for its 'Land of Fire' heritage, modern architecture in Baku, and Caspian Sea coastline.

maps.name: Jordan
maps.description: Jordan is a Middle Eastern country known for its ancient historical sites, including the rock-carved city of Petra, the mineral-rich Dead Sea, and vast desert landscapes.

maps.name: Lebanon
maps.description: Lebanon is a small, mountainous country on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea, celebrated for its rich history, vibrant culture, and renowned culinary traditions.

maps.name: Oman
maps.description: Oman is an Arab country on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, known for its rugged mountains, historic forts, and pristine desert and coastal landscapes.

maps.name: Kenya
maps.description: Kenya is an East African country renowned for its classic savanna safaris, diverse wildlife, the Great Rift Valley, and a vibrant cultural heritage.

maps.name: Kuwait
maps.description: Kuwait is a small, wealthy Middle Eastern country on the Persian Gulf, known for its modern architecture, significant oil reserves, and rich maritime history.

maps.name: Cambodia
maps.description: Cambodia is a Southeast Asian nation famous for the majestic Angkor Wat temple complex, rich Khmer history, and the scenic landscapes of the Mekong River.

maps.name: Myanmar
maps.description: Myanmar is a Southeast Asian country known for its thousands of ancient Buddhist temples, diverse ethnic cultures, and the iconic golden Shwedagon Pagoda.

maps.name: Nepal
maps.description: Nepal is a landlocked Himalayan country in South Asia, globally celebrated as the home of Mount Everest and a rich tapestry of Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

maps.name: Sri Lanka
maps.description: Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, known for its ancient ruins, beautiful beaches, diverse wildlife, and world-renowned Ceylon tea.

maps.name: Ghana
maps.description: Ghana is a West African country known for its diverse wildlife, historic coastal forts, beautiful beaches, and being the first sub-Saharan African nation to gain independence.

maps.name: Tanzania
maps.description: Tanzania is an East African country famous for its vast wilderness areas, including the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Crater, and the iconic Mount Kilimanjaro.

maps.name: Cuba
maps.description: Cuba is a Caribbean island nation known for its vibrant culture, classic vintage cars, pristine beaches, and historic colonial architecture in cities like Havana.

maps.name: Hong Kong
maps.description: Hong Kong is a special administrative region of China, renowned as a major global financial hub with a stunning skyline, deep natural harbor, and vibrant street culture.

maps.name: Taiwan
maps.description: Taiwan is an island in East Asia known for its bustling night markets, advanced technology industry, and stunning natural landscapes including mountains and hot springs.

maps.name: Qatar
maps.description: Qatar is a small, wealthy peninsula country in the Middle East, famous for its futuristic skyline in Doha, vast natural gas reserves, and modern infrastructure.

maps.name: Angola
maps.description: Angola is a Southern African country with a diverse landscape of tropical Atlantic beaches, a vast interior plateau, and rich natural resources including oil and diamonds.

maps.name: Guatemala
maps.description: Guatemala is a Central American country known for its rich Mayan heritage, stunning volcanic landscapes, and the historic colonial city of Antigua.

maps.name: Syria
maps.description: Syria is a Middle Eastern country with a profound ancient history, home to some of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities and significant archaeological sites.

maps.name: Sudan
maps.description: Sudan is a large Northeast African country where the Blue and White Nile rivers meet, known for its ancient Nubian pyramids and diverse cultural heritage.

maps.name: Tunisia
maps.description: Tunisia is the northernmost country in Africa, celebrated for its ancient Carthaginian ruins, Mediterranean beaches, and the edge of the Sahara Desert.

maps.name: Uganda
maps.description: Uganda is a landlocked East African country known as the 'Pearl of Africa,' famous for its diverse wildlife, including mountain gorillas, and the source of the Nile.

maps.name: Yemen
maps.description: Yemen is an Arab country on the southern end of the Arabian Peninsula, known for its ancient architecture, unique culture, and historic port city of Aden.

maps.name: Zambia
maps.description: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa, renowned for the majestic Victoria Falls, abundant wildlife, and numerous expansive national parks.
